_comment: Chroma SINGLE-GPU offload FULL fine-tune (no LoRA). See chroma/train.py. HOST RAM BUDGET is the binding constraint, not VRAM: ~36 GB fp32 masters + ~36 GB grad accumulators (pinned under grad_accum='stream') + ~36 GB pinned .grad buffers + ~72 GB AdamW state = ~180 GB. The GPU only ever holds (window+pin) chunks.
_comment_chunks: fp32 masters mean every chunk is 2x the bf16 size, so PCIe traffic doubles: keep the window deep enough to stay ahead of compute. offload_grad_accum='stream' matters most here — it keeps the gradient arithmetic on the GPU and spills once at flush instead of writing back per microbatch (26% faster than 'cpu' in krea2's full-FT measurements; the losing choice for lora).
_comment_batch: batch_size is PER MICROBATCH; effective batch = batch_size * n_microbatches.
_comment_ckpt: Path to the Chroma base weights (safetensors, native flow keys). See checkpoints/README.md.
_comment_mode: full mode resume priority: full_checkpoint > lora_checkpoint (merged into chroma_checkpoint) > chroma_checkpoint.
